params.comment: The Pages tab reads your site from here. origin is its production URL: replace https://www.example.com/ with yours. For a built folder instead, set site_dir (such as dist, which needs an index.html) and origin to an empty string. key_pages lists one path per page role, as craft-site rule 1 writes them. src_dirs is where your styles live. tokens names your design tokens file, the one source of the palette, or stays null.
Keep origin, site_dir and key_pages the same as design.raw_hex. crawl_skip lists paths that are not pages, such as an API or a download.

platform pages reads GitHub Pages deploys through the GitHub API. For a Cloudflare Worker, delete platform, set worker_dir to the folder that holds its Wrangler config, and log in to Wrangler (wrangler-login).

Where the site's tests live. The End to end suite holds the browser tests for craft-site rules 2 to 5. pages_dir and page_file find each page's source, so the tab counts the pages no browser test opens.
